subject: QMon onboarding runway + canary/rollback checkpoints
messages:
From: Emma Wright <emma.wright@nexameds.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: QMon integration and onboarding runway

Rafael,

Thanks for taking this on. We're ready to start wiring Redwood's quality monitoring into our deployment pipeline. High level asks:
- Integrate our prompt sets into your eval harness and run baseline evals this week.
- Set up regression alerts for the two highest-risk intents (prior auth, med reconciliation).
- Canary strategy for the initial model swap (small % traffic, readiness checks, rollback plan).

Attached is our initial prompt set export and a short list of examples. We can share API keys for staging. Ideally we want to be able to flag regressions before the October 8th pilot.

Attaching: nexameds-qmon-mapping.xlsx (prompt IDs + labels)

Emma Wright
Product Manager, NexaMed
emma.wright@nexameds.com
+1 415-555-0182
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Emma Wright <emma.wright@nexameds.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 16:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: QMon integration and onboarding runway

Emma — thanks for the clear asks and the prompt export. Brief plan below; I copied the implementation and quality leads so we're aligned.

1) Baseline evals: Lauren and I will ingest the prompt set into our eval harness in the staging account. Expect initial signal reports (coverage, accuracy, embedding drift) within 48 hours.
2) Regression alerts: We'll wire two guardrails for the intents you called out:
   - Thresholds: F1 drop >= 6% or exact-match fall >= 8% triggers high-severity alert
   - Actions: Auto-notify NexaMed SRE + CS, suppress model rollout if severity persists across two consecutive runs
3) Canary plan: see attached canary-rollback-matrix.csv — proposed cadence is 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 48-hour windows with blackbox acceptance checks and KV-cache warmup.
4) Mutual action plan: I've drafted a MAP and attached it (nxm-mutual-action-plan.md) with owners and dates — please confirm owners for the integration tasks (API keys, dataset access, SLOs).

Can we confirm staging API keys and a point contact on the engineering side? Tom + Emma? Also looping Dylan from our runtime team for KV/cache warmup guidance.

Next steps: if you approve the MAP and canary cadence today we can schedule the eval ingest tomorrow morning.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
From: Tom Chen <tomc@nexameds.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Wright <emma.wright@nexameds.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: QMon integration and onboarding runway

Thanks — quick technical clarifications before we hand keys over: 
- Eval harness: do you expect a single batch upload of prompt/expected pairs, or will you call our eval endpoint? We can support both.
- Telemetry: we need the schema for regression alerts (webhook payload) so our SRE can onboard receivers.
- Canary traffic split: will you be using route-based sampling or token-proxy percentage? Token-proxy is preferable for us.

On owners: I'll be the engineering point for API/key exchange. Emma — can I get the staging API key in a secure vault?

--
Tom Chen
Lead Software Engineer, NexaMed
tomc@nexameds.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tom Chen <tomc@nexameds.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: QMon integration and onboarding runway

Tom / team — answering the technical bits and adding the canary/rollback checks we'll run from the Eval + QMon side. Attaching the canary-rollback-matrix.csv with thresholds. Highlights:
- Eval ingest: we can do both (batch upload or direct call). For rapid iteration, upload the prompt/answer CSV and we will run scheduled evals every 6 hours.
- Webhook: regression alert schema is attached as a sample payload and I put a short onboarding checklist in the MAP.
- Traffic split: Redwood runtime supports both route-sampling and token-proxy. For NexaMed I recommend token-proxy + KV warmup (reduces cold-token variance).

Quick ask for NexaMed: please flag any PII redaction rules before we ingest. If you prefer, we can run a redaction pass in staging and share the scrubbed sets with you.

Lauren Bishop
Product Manager, Quality Monitoring | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Emma Wright <emma.wright@nexameds.com>, Tom Chen <tomc@nexameds.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: QMon integration and onboarding runway

Thanks everyone — alignment summary and next steps: 
- NexaMed to upload prompt/answer CSV to the Secure Drive link (I shared via Drive) by EOD today.
- Tom will provision a staging API key and set up an SRE webhook endpoint (target: tomorrow).
- Lauren + I will ingest prompts and post the first baseline report within 24 hours of the upload.
- Canary cadence approved: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 48h windows; rollback criteria per matrix (F1 drop >=6% or user-impacting failure rate >3%).
- Dylan will run KV cache warmup guidance and confirm runtime knobs for token-proxy.

We aim for pilot date: 2026-10-08 (NexaMed product pilot). I'll open a short status thread each morning this week until baseline is complete. If anything blocks you, mark it as high on the MAP and ping me directly.

Attachments referenced: nexameds-qmon-mapping.xlsx, nxm-mutual-action-plan.md, canary-rollback-matrix.csv

Rafael Mendes
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
